Review found a valid reversal receipt with 16 allocations, 16 tags, merchant and 256 four-byte reason characters could exceed the existing 4096-byte receipt bound. Reversal receipts now have an 8192-byte bound at both write and restore admission; original transaction bounds remain unchanged. The maximum combination passes post, replay, backup and restore.
